Silicon Decathlon

Trained models from the ProjectJoy shelf, each raced across every engine on one Apple M5 Max: NumPy, MLX on CPU and GPU, and Core ML on CPU, GPU and Neural Engine. An athlete only gets a medal if its output is still the same model (the event's qualifying rule).

Batch
Measure

Details

Agreement is against the MLX GPU fp32 reference on the same inputs. Placement is Core ML's compute plan (ops per preferred device).

Medal table

Gold, silver, bronze per event and batch size among qualifying athletes, by median latency. Core ML athletes whose compute plan put no op on the unit they asked for are left out: they ran on the CPU. TF32 athletes (*_tf32, badge "exhibition") ran in a separate process with no task check and get no medal.
